name: Dice Rolling
description: Provides advanced dice rolling capabilities for tabletop gaming and RPGs with support for standard notation, advantage/disadvantage mechanics, exploding dice, reroll mechanics, keep/drop highest/lowest, success counting, and special dice types including fudge dice and percentile dice.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search dice rolling documentation, guides, and examples

query.description: Search query to find relevant dice rolling information, examples, or notation help

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Retrieve detailed content for a specific dice rolling topic by ID

id.description: ID of the dice rolling topic to fetch (from search results)

tools.name: dice_roll
tools.description: Roll dice using standard notation. IMPORTANT: For D&D advantage use '2d20kh1' (NOT '2d20')

verbose.description: Show detailed breakdown of individual dice results

tools.name: dice_validate
tools.description: Validate and explain dice notation without rolling

notation.description: Dice notation to validate and explain. Examples: "2d20kh1+5", "4d6kh3", "8d6", "1d%"
